verdict.rationale: New Relic publishes a free-tier ingest figure (100GB/month) but the evidence pack shows no detailed transparent per-signal price list (e.g., $/GB, $/user, $/host) that would let an SRE model costs unaided; multiple hands-on community reports describe opaque, surprising billing changes (per-user pricing spikes, being billed 3x for non-prod environments, region/AZ multiplication, ingest overages) that directly contradict the idea of predictable self-service cost estimation. missing for 10: a published per-signal price sheet, evidence of accurate self-serve cost calculators, and corroboration that customers can predict bills without sales engagement.
